description: This file defines an abstract class 'dmQuery' with virtual methods for executing, resetting, setting query strings, and retrieving results, as part of a data management or query system.

classes.name: dmQuery
classes.description: An abstract class representing a data management query interface with methods for execution, reset, setting query strings, and retrieving results.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the query; returns true if successful.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the query to its initial state.

methods.name: setQueryString
methods.description: Sets the query string with a specified provider operation.

methods.name: results
methods.description: Retrieves the results of the query.
